ctr_personnel.name: Proactive Partnership has benefited schedule developmentWe consistently collaborate with our NG counterparts as they build BOEs, schedules, and other artifacts, allowing us to ensure a common understanding of portfolio scope and discuss concerns early on. 2. Artifacts are still in early development stagesWhile we are evaluating what we can for BOEs and schedules, these are still in development and missing logic, durations, etc. We anticipate some rework as we evaluate early products that are still being updated. 3. Schedule pressures There is pressure to create an aggressive schedule to meet IOC dates, and our concern is that logic or durations may be optimistic rather than realistic in order to show an ability to meet key milestones.

data.leadership_messages: We have moderate confidence in the planning foundation for development of schedule artifacts. Open communication and a solid relationship will enable collaborative discussions, but schedules in previous years that were missing key logic or scope leave us with some definite concerns that we will be looking for in future evaluations.
data.rationale: The schedule is in the early stages of development so the logic ties and details we want to evaluate are not mature. The training system is heavily dependent on the weapons system maturity and logic ties are instrumental in our evaluation. Much of the trainer scope are in high level packages that don’t provide enough detail to evaluate.

areas.text: Our expectation is that we have cross-product/cross-function integration within the schedule however, the contractor has not shown that level of fidelity in their current schedule, yet.

data.questions: At this early stage, our main concern is that logic ties will be missing, so we will be evaluating future schedules for that logic. We are also concerned about overly optimistic durations and/or lack of logic given the pressure to create a schedule that meets the overarching Level 1-3 schedule milestones. This software CA is separated from our other Training related CA making it difficult to track and monitor. It will require additional effort in the future to ensure both teams are tracking this data.
data.integration: In future schedule meetings, we will be working with NG to understand how WS data dependencies are being captured in the schedule logic. We will also want to see how the software ties into the training devices and training services portfolios. With it being separated out, it will be imperative to track how it is integrated back into the training system.
